meta.title: 存6️⃣个小韩松弛感拍照姿势🩵🐋🫧
meta.title_en: Save These 6 Korean Relaxed Photo Poses
meta.topic: 拍照教学 · 韩系松弛感

scenes.title_en: Pose 1: Triangle and a Casual Head Raise
scenes.context: 一个三角形，两个三角形，然后不经意的抬头。韩系拍照：用三角形构图，不经意抬头营造松弛感。语域：拍照教学，动作口令。
sentences: 一个三角形，两个三角形。
One triangle, two triangles.
triangle（三角形）
然后不经意的抬头。
Then casually raise your head.
casually raise（不经意抬头）
三角构图，画面就有重心。
Triangular composition gives the frame a focal point.
a focal point（重心）
paraphrase: 三角构图 → triangular composition / triangle framing
不经意抬头 → casually raise / a nonchalant look-up
scenes.speak: One triangle, two triangles. Then casually raise your head. Triangular composition gives the frame a focal point.

scenes.title_cn: 姿势2-3：抬胳膊叉腰 + 背影撩发
scenes.title_en: Poses 2–3: Arm Up on Hip, and Back View
scenes.context: 如果侧身站显胳膊粗，就抬起胳膊伸到叉腰，露出项链遮粗臂。拍背影时把所有头发都放到前面，露出肩颈线条，托住脸来一张。语域：拍照教学，动作口令。
sentences: 侧身站显胳膊粗，就抬起胳膊叉腰。
If side-on shows thick arms, raise your arm to your hip.
thick arms（胳膊粗）
拍背影时，把所有头发都放到前面。
For a back view, sweep all your hair forward.
sweep hair forward（头发放前）
露出肩颈线条，更显瘦。
Reveal the neck and shoulder lines for a slimmer look.
neck and shoulder lines（肩颈线条）
paraphrase: 叉腰 → hand on hip / arm to the hip
肩颈线条 → neck and shoulder lines / the collarbone line
scenes.speak: If side-on shows thick arms, raise your arm to your hip. For a back view, sweep all your hair forward. Reveal the neck and shoulder lines for a slimmer look.

scenes.title_cn: 姿势4-5：滑肩带托腮 + 假戴耳机
scenes.title_en: Poses 4–5: Slipped Strap and Fake Headphones
scenes.context: 把外侧肩带放下来，用衣服挡住里侧的肉肉，托住脸拍一张。还可以假装戴耳机，同时身体向前倾，日常感十足。语域：拍照教学，动作口令。
sentences: 把外侧肩带放下来，用衣服挡住肉肉。
Slip the outer strap down and let the fabric cover your arms.
slip the strap（滑落肩带）
然后托住脸来一张。
Then rest your chin on your hand for the shot.
rest your chin（托脸）
假装戴耳机，身体向前倾，日常感十足。
Fake the headphones and lean forward — it feels so everyday.
everyday feel（日常感）
paraphrase: 托脸 → rest the chin / chin in hand
日常感 → everyday feel / casual vibe
scenes.speak: Slip the outer strap down and let the fabric cover your arms. Then rest your chin on your hand for the shot. Fake the headphones and lean forward — it feels so everyday.

scenes.title_cn: 姿势6：一脚点地一脚半曲
scenes.title_en: Pose 6: One Foot Pointed, One Half-Bent
scenes.context: 动作很高的时候，要一条腿自然点地，另外一条腿放到一半，这样显腿长又自然。直接做什么动作都很自然。语域：拍照教学，收尾。
sentences: 动作高的时候，一条腿自然点地。
When the pose is tall, let one foot naturally point down.
naturally point（自然点地）
另外一条腿放到一半。
Bend the other leg halfway.
bend halfway（放到一半）
这样显腿长，做什么动作都自然。
It lengthens the legs, and any move looks natural.
lengthens the legs（显腿长）
paraphrase: 点地 → point down / touch the ground
显腿长 → lengthen the legs / elongate the look
scenes.speak: When the pose is tall, let one foot naturally point down. Bend the other leg halfway. It lengthens the legs, and any move looks natural.

practice: One triangle, two triangles, then casually raise your head.
Sweep all your hair forward to reveal the neck and shoulder lines.
Slip the outer strap down and rest your chin on your hand.
Let one foot naturally point down and bend the other leg halfway.
pitfalls: Make one triangle and two triangles.
One triangle, two triangles — a triangular composition.
Raise your hand to the waist.
Raise your arm to your hip.
「叉腰」用 hand on hip，是 hip 不是 waist。
Reveal the neck and shoulder lines.
「露出肩颈线条」用 reveal the lines。
One leg is half and one is point.
One foot naturally points down and the other bends halfway.
「一点地一半曲」用 point down / bend halfway。
shifts: 用 triangular composition（三角构图）、casually raise（不经意抬头）、slip the strap（滑肩带）
用 neck and shoulder lines（肩颈线条）、slimmer look（显瘦）、lengthen the legs（显腿长）
用 everyday feel（日常感）、casual vibe（松弛感）、nonchalant（不经意的）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：特身→侧身、战显→显、矮腰→叉腰、脸链→项链/肩链→肩带、盆线→发线、掩地→点地、先垂手→显腿长、小韩→韩系、松弛感等。
